::: {#exm-hers-risk-ratio}
#### Risk ratio of regular exercise in HERS

With the placebo group as the reference group,
the estimated risk ratio of @def-risk-ratio
for the estimated risks of @exm-hers-outcome-risk is:

```{r}
#| label: hers-risk-ratio
#| code-fold: false
rr_hat <- risk_hat[["hormone therapy"]] / risk_hat[["placebo"]]
rr_hat
```

The estimated risk of regular exercise in the hormone therapy group
is `r round(rr_hat, 3)` times the estimated risk in the placebo group.
A risk ratio near 1 agrees with the large p-value of @exm-hers-chisq:
the two groups have about the same risk.
:::
